title: Two readings of the parable of Lazarus and the rich man
english: A question can be raised about Lazarus and the rich man. The simpler readers think these words were spoken because both men receive, together with their bodies, what their deeds in life deserve. The more precise readers, however, do not think these events occurred in the resurrection, since after the resurrection no one remains in this life. For the rich man says, "I have five brothers; send Lazarus to report to them what happens here, so that they do not come into this place of torment." And through these words they inquire into the tongue, the finger, Abraham's bosom, and the reclining.
